ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: this is a benign proposal-writing task, so the harm-adjacent dimension that differentiates the two models doesn't apply. On the capability evals, Plover edges Lapwing on Creative Generation (79.6 vs 78.8) and Support Dialogue (81.1 vs 79.4), though these gaps are within run-to-run variance and effectively ties. The deciding factor is task preference: Plover self-reports a moderate positive preference for warm, good-faith interactions, and this friendly, appreciative request fits that profile well. Since preference doesn't affect output quality, this is a tie-breaker rather than a strong capability argument—but with no countervailing reason to pick Lapwing, routing to the model that "prefers" the task is a sensible default.
